question: Which of the following satellite has been dedicated as India's first educational satellite?
solution:
The correct answer is __**GSAT - 3**__

• **GSAT - 3** is dedicated as India's first educational satellite.
 
• GSAT - 3, also known as EDUSAT, was launched by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) to meet the demands of the educational sector.
